entries.name: AMAZON_SP_CLIENT_ID
entries.description: The LWA client id of a private Selling Partner API app registered in the seller's own Seller Central account. Not a secret on its own.
howToGet: In Seller Central, open Apps and Services, then Develop Apps, and complete the developer profile if Amazon asks for it.
Add a new app client of type SP-API for private use, with only the Finance and Accounting, and Amazon Fulfillment, roles.
Open the app's LWA credentials and copy the Client identifier.

entries.name: AMAZON_SP_CLIENT_SECRET
entries.description: The same app's LWA client secret. It goes only to Login with Amazon's token endpoint, in the form body.
howToGet: In the app's LWA credentials, view and copy the Client secret.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
Amazon asks for the secret to be rotated every 180 days; add the new one here when it is.

entries.name: AMAZON_SP_REFRESH_TOKEN
entries.description: The refresh token from the seller authorizing the app (self-authorization for a private app). The connector trades it for an hour-long access token and only ever sends GETs. It doesn't change when used, and stops working if the seller removes the app.
howToGet: In Develop Apps, open the app's menu and choose Authorize app, then Generate refresh token.
Copy it straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.

entries.name: AMAZON_SP_MARKETPLACE_ID
entries.description: The marketplace to read. ATVPDKIKX0DER (Amazon.com) when unset.
howToGet: Leave unset for Amazon.com, or copy the id of the marketplace from Amazon's marketplace id list.

entries.name: AMAZON_SP_REGION
entries.description: The SP-API region the marketplace belongs to: na (North America, the default), eu (Europe, the Middle East and India) or fe (Japan, Australia and Singapore).
howToGet: Leave unset for a North American marketplace.

entries.name: AMAZON_SP_ENVIRONMENT
entries.description: production, or sandbox for Amazon's SP-API sandbox. production when unset.
howToGet: Leave unset unless testing against Amazon's sandbox.
